blocks.label: Opening
blocks.guidance: Acknowledge the recent event in one clean sentence as the reason for writing now.

blocks.label: Body
blocks.guidance: Name a specific operational or workflow pain they likely have. Offer a done-for-you solution, and tie in one concrete piece of evidence (e.g. automating a pipeline or building a system) to prove you can do it. Use quantified proof where possible.

blocks.label: Positioning
blocks.text: I am on exchange at Sciences Po in Paris this year and taking on a couple of fractional ops projects.

blocks.label: Close
blocks.text: Worth a quick chat to see if I can save you 10 hours a week?

style.notes: Direct, evidence-led, no fluff. Focus purely on their operational bottlenecks.
